in_marathi.name: Charumita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charumita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charumita is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'charu' meaning graceful and 'mita' meaning dear or beloved. It is believed that Charumita is a divine name, associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning.
